python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0027:
# Pose 26: (0.616, 2.299), heading 60
# Action 27: turn -30 (heading 30), move 0.5:
# delta = 0.5 * (sin 30, cos 30) = (0.25, 0.433)
# Pose 27: x = 0.616 + 0.25 = 0.866, y = 2.299 + 0.433 = 2.732, heading 30.

arr27 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0027.png"))
sofa_m = (arr27[:, :, 0] > 85) & (arr27[:, :, 0] < 125) & (arr27[:, :, 1] > 90) & (arr27[:, :, 1] < 130) & (arr27[:, :, 2] > 95) & (arr27[:, :, 2] < 140)
y_s, x_s = np.where(sofa_m)
print(f"Sofa in obs_0027: x range [{x_s.min()}, {x_s.max()}], cx = {x_s.mean():.1f}, bottom y = {y_s.max()}")

f = 256.0
H = 1.55
cy0 = 255.5
cx0 = 255.5

D_s = f * H / (y_s.max() - cy0)
cx_s = x_s.mean()
alpha_s = (cx_s - cx0) / f
pos_sofa = np.array([0.866, 2.732]) + D_s * np.array([np.sin(np.radians(30)), np.cos(np.radians(30))]) + (alpha_s * D_s) * np.array([np.cos(np.radians(30)), -np.sin(np.radians(30))])
print(f"Sofa from obs_0027: D={D_s:.3f}, x={pos_sofa[0]:.3f}, y={pos_sofa[1]:.3f}")

# Also east wall boundary:
# The corner where north wall and east wall meet!
# In obs_0027, the corner vertical line is visible at x around 250!
'
